questions.text: Locate rich.markup.escape.

targets.name: escape
targets.rationale: Escapes bracket markup and handles backslashes including a trailing single backslash.

questions.text: Find AnsiDecoder.decode, the iterator that decodes terminal text line by line.

targets.name: AnsiDecoder.decode
targets.rationale: Splits the input into lines and yields each decode_line result.

questions.text: Where is Measurement.get implemented?

targets.name: Measurement.get
targets.rationale: Normalizes renderables and invokes their measurement hook within the available width.

questions.text: Locate Console.export_text for reading recorded console output.

targets.name: Console.export_text
targets.rationale: Collects recorded segments into plain or styled text and optionally clears the buffer.

questions.text: Which method disables automatic color detection for nonterminal or dumb-terminal output?

targets.name: Console._detect_color_system
targets.rationale: Returns None for nonterminals or dumb terminals after checking the Jupyter case.

questions.text: Where does a markup closing tag with no matching open style raise an error?

targets.name: render
targets.rationale: Raises MarkupError when a named closing style cannot be found or the anonymous stack is empty.

questions.text: Which ANSI decoder keeps only the text following the final carriage return on a line?

targets.name: AnsiDecoder.decode_line
targets.rationale: Uses line.rsplit with a carriage-return separator before tokenizing ANSI content.

questions.text: Which implementation splits non-control segments at newline characters while carrying their styles to each line?

targets.name: Segment.split_lines
targets.rationale: Partitions ordinary segment text around newlines and yields lists of styled segments.

questions.text: Where is a rendered segment line padded with spaces or cropped to a requested cell width?

targets.name: Segment.adjust_line_length
targets.rationale: Computes cell length, appends padding when short and truncates segments when too long.

questions.text: Which class method combines an iterable of styles by accumulating them in order?

targets.name: Style.combine
targets.rationale: Starts with the first style and sums the remaining styles from the iterator.

questions.text: Where does text truncation reserve one display cell for an ellipsis?

targets.name: Text.truncate
targets.rationale: For ellipsis overflow, resizes the plain text to max_width minus one and appends the ellipsis.

questions.text: Which code omits control segments from plain recorded text and clears the recording buffer by default?

targets.name: Console.export_text
targets.rationale: The unstyled branch ignores control segments; clear defaults true and deletes the buffer contents.

questions.text: Trace console rendering into the helper that repeatedly applies __rich__ conversions.

targets.name: Console.render
targets.rationale: Normalizes the renderable with rich_cast before selecting the rendering protocol.

targets.name: rich_cast
targets.rationale: Calls __rich__ while tracking visited result types to avoid an endless conversion chain.

questions.text: Which console string-rendering method delegates enabled markup to the parser in the markup module?

targets.name: Console.render_str
targets.rationale: Calls render_markup when markup_enabled is true.

targets.name: render
targets.rationale: Parses markup into text and style spans.

questions.text: Trace Text.from_markup into the function that creates its styled text representation.

targets.name: Text.from_markup
targets.rationale: Imports markup.render, calls it and applies text layout settings.

targets.name: render
targets.rationale: Builds text and style spans from markup tags.

questions.text: Which Text constructor delegates ANSI decoding to a separate module and joins the decoded lines?

targets.name: Text.from_ansi
targets.rationale: Creates AnsiDecoder and joins the results of decoder.decode with newline text.

targets.name: AnsiDecoder.decode
targets.rationale: Yields decoded Text objects one input line at a time.

questions.text: Trace Console.measure to the implementation that invokes a renderable's __rich_measure__ hook.

targets.name: Console.measure
targets.rationale: Forwards the renderable and effective console options to Measurement.get.

targets.name: Measurement.get
targets.rationale: Calls the measurement hook and constrains its result to the maximum width.

questions.text: Which Text property and cell utility compute display width rather than Python string length?

targets.name: Text.cell_len
targets.rationale: Delegates the plain string to the imported cell_len utility.

targets.name: cell_len
targets.rationale: Uses cached cell widths for shorter strings and sums per-character widths for long strings.

questions.text: Trace truncating text to a terminal width into the helper that avoids splitting a double-width character.

targets.name: Text.truncate
targets.rationale: Calls set_cell_size to resize text before assigning the truncated plain value.

targets.name: set_cell_size
targets.rationale: Finds a fitting prefix and substitutes a space when a double-width character straddles the boundary.

questions.text: Which padding measurement implementation delegates to another module before adding horizontal padding?

targets.name: Padding.__rich_measure__
targets.rationale: Measures the wrapped renderable and adds left and right padding within max_width.

targets.name: Measurement.get
targets.rationale: Obtains and normalizes the underlying renderable's measurement.

questions.text: Which test checks escaping markup tags while leaving a numeric bracket expression untouched?

targets.name: test_escape
targets.rationale: Checks escaped bar and metadata tags, existing backslashes and unchanged [5] expressions.

questions.text: Find the test covering both padding and cropping a list of rendered segments.

targets.name: test_adjust_line_length
targets.rationale: Asserts padding with a specified style, cropping multiple segments and unchanged equal-width lines.

questions.text: Which parameterized test checks ellipsis truncation down to a one-character output?

targets.name: test_truncate_ellipsis
targets.rationale: Checks the output for several requested widths including an ellipsis alone at width one.

questions.text: Which test verifies that recording bold console text can be exported as plain text?

targets.name: test_export_text
targets.rationale: Prints bold markup to a recording console and asserts the export contains plain foo and a newline.
